description:
(Summary from jobright.ai; the original posting may say more.)

Asure Software develops human capital management software and services for businesses. The Associate Software Engineer will build and support backend applications, .NET APIs, and cloud-based solutions, collaborating with engineers and product teams to deliver reliable software.
Associate Software Engineer building .NET backend services and APIs, integrating SQL databases, and supporting Terraform cloud provisioning

Responsibilities:
• Design, develop, test, and maintain backend applications and services
• Build and enhance APIs using .NET technologies
• Collaborate with cross-functional teams to gather requirements and deliver technical solutions
• Develop and support applications using modern software engineering best practices
• Write clean, maintainable, and well-documented code
• Participate in code reviews and contribute to continuous improvement initiatives
• Support cloud infrastructure provisioning and deployment activities using Terraform
• Troubleshoot and resolve application, database, and performance issues
• Create and optimize SQL queries, stored procedures, and database integrations
• Participate in Agile development processes, including sprint planning, standups, and retrospectives
• Assist in monitoring, maintaining, and improving application reliability and scalability

Requirements:
• Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Technology, or related field, or equivalent practical experience
• 1-3 years of professional software development experience (internship experience may be considered)
• Experience developing backend services and APIs using C# and .NET
• Working knowledge of SQL databases and database design concepts
• Understanding of object-oriented programming principles and software design patterns
• Familiarity with version control tools such as Git
• Strong analytical, problem-solving, and communication skills
• Ability to work effectively in a collaborative team environment
• C#
• .NET / .NET Core
• REST APIs
• Microservices concepts
• C#
• TypeScript
• JavaScript
• Terraform
• Cloud platforms (Azure preferred)
• SQL Server
• Relational database design
• Query optimization
• Git
• Azure DevOps or similar CI/CD tools
• All candidates must be legally authorized to work in the US, as we are unable to sponsor or transfer Visas at this time

Preferred:
• Exposure to Node.js and TypeScript development
• Experience with Infrastructure as Code (IaC), preferably Terraform
• Experience working with cloud platforms such as Azure or AWS
• Knowledge of CI/CD pipelines and DevOps practices
• Familiarity with containerization technologies such as Docker
• Understanding of API security, authentication, and authorization standards
• Experience working in Agile/Scrum environments
• Passion for learning new technologies and engineering practices
• Strong attention to detail and commitment to quality
• Ability to balance multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment
• Collaborative mindset and willingness to receive and provide feedback
• Desire to grow technical expertise in backend and cloud-native development
